summary: Genmab A/S furnished a Form 6-K incorporating a company announcement disclosing transactions by managerial employees and closely associated persons under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation (the non-US equivalent of a Section 16 insider-transaction report). CEO Jan van de Winkel sold shares at DKK prices ranging roughly 3,581 to 3,658, reducing his holding from 668,024 to 646,024 shares. No corporate action, deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is routine insider-dealing disclosure; there is no risk-arb or event angle to monitor.
